public_entry.python: poise.interfaces.project_checks.execute(config_path, checkout, policy_path, stream, output, error_output, clock)
public_entry.raw_machine_result: Python port emits complete canonical result JSON (ensure_ascii=False, sorted keys, compact separators, one LF); complete raw stdout/stderr remain file-backed. CLI saves the full result through common owner and prints its configured common view. Full view is a file link only. Early invalid project/unavailable storage cannot invent response_path: emit complete small typed error and real exit. No independent per-tool clipping.
public_entry.outputs: view/semantic parser errors retain raw record truth. Raw record/data returned to code never uses preview text as input.
public_entry.pre_entry_red: Every new behavior test calls actual CLI checks --help inside CALL before importing future product module; exactly exit2/empty stdout/usage and argument command invalid choice checks maps to NamedChecksUnavailable(code=None). Other outcomes keep original failure.
public_entry.batch: 1..configured batch.max_items items; validate complete request/selection/schema before first launch; preserve declared order. Per-step actual prerequisite/runtime failure stops remaining steps and marks them not_executed; prior actual results stay visible.
public_entry.aggregate: list/describe/result ready; preview planned; all executed requested runs passed => passed; otherwise first actual nonpassed item status in declared order. Calibrate all published/unchanged => published if any wrote, otherwise unchanged; partial publication unconfirmed. Structural errors invalid; runtime/dependency unavailable; genuinely unknown terminal observation unknown.
public_entry.exit_codes: 0 ready/planned/passed/published/unchanged; 2 invalid; 3 unavailable; 1 failed/unconfirmed/timed_out/stalled/cancelled/unknown or caller-output failure. Actual child code retained separately, not replaced by transport exit.

semantics.normalization: Request and receipt root/known schemas strict, duplicate JSON keys rejected, bool is not int. Nonempty bounded IDs/selectors; unknown optional text selector values may warn-and-ignore only as documented donor selection rule, then require unique candidate; unknown request fields rejected. Known malformed typed options rejected. Unknown configuration keys ignored with raw values retained for publication. Explicit options are required; no hidden defaults/legacy alias or executable/root fallback.
semantics.profile_config: TOML retains schema1 and source profile axes/fields; adopted explicit input_selection and nullable cache limits remove hidden defaults. IDs max96 donor syntax. Correct configured profile has executable argv/nonempty platform set/relative cwd; known numeric values finite and correct bounds. Evidence references exist. Unknown known-field enums rejected. Subject capability is explicit and not conditioned on an ERP command ID. Both working and committed documentation profiles require cache.enabled=false and exactly one configured mode_argument followed by matching mode.
semantics.package_config: Existing ERP TOML semantics retained with generic policy-configured driver IDs replacing ERP application-name switches. Native argv prefix plus explicit arguments/test paths; relative paths stay inside selected declared application prefix. Stable owners/kinds/contracts/dependencies/producer-consumer/bidirectional/triggers/shared boundaries retained; no native worker or repository parallel fields invented. Inventory covers actual tests; duplicates need exact shared_tests package set/reason; cycles/missing dependency/unknown drivers fail before execution. Suite fast/release/source scopes ordered; ambiguity/unmapped scope never silently selects full suite.
semantics.profile_dto_unknown_values: Description may retain unknown profile values via original raw document; normalized known DTO type may be evaluated independently. No renderer deletes raw keys. Tests compare typed known result fields and whole original unknown nested values after publication.
semantics.progress: Actual donor input modes are regex and unavailable. A durable progress file is output, not an invented new file-input mode. Regex groups/monotonic completed values observed through sole process owner; unavailable means no progress sample or invented stall. Execution/stall limits follow explicit profile/policy values. No per-method Task timeout added.
semantics.parser_confirmation: confirmed means recognized summary, as actual donor. Preserve all14 literal parser outputs/counts/failure items. Nonzero actual exit remains failed; zero exit missing REQUIRED recognition is unconfirmed; incomplete declared evidence unconfirmed. Zero exit with recognized failure/error summary follows donor passed/verified_success rules even with require_parser_confirmation:true; expose exact counts/items, never call recognition independent all-tests-passed proof. No universal new failure-count/status predicate.
semantics.history_clock: Only same project/command/workload/runtime identity, verified successful complete run samples are eligible; history is operational calibration, not source-proof reuse, and intentionally differs from cache exact-input identity. Each duration uses comparable injected Clock start/end; production SystemClock, deterministic tests scripted FakeClock. UTC only audit. Different domain/end-before-start excludes sample with clock_incomparable and preserves known process result, never clamps. Margin/poll/cleanup/override max are explicit policy. Calibration example initial10, valid durations1 and2, failed9: longest2, margin1.10 => ceil2.2=3. Progress gap0.8 => ceil0.88=1. No initial floor after compatible history, matching donor.
semantics.override: seconds exceeds derived ordinary limit and is <=explicit maximum; named timed_out/stalled same-profile evidence, unconsumed and not itself override. Validate before spawn and consume through run ledger owner once; caller-output failure after committed run does not undo consumption. No chained override or automatic rerun.
semantics.cache: Actual ordinary namespace key_schema + command_id + workload_class + selected/scoped inputs_sha256; package namespace test-package-source-test-fixtures-v2 + command_id + package_id + content_sha256. No added top-level profile/runtime/environment/absolutecheckout/HEAD. Preserve actual used input owner INSIDE inputs_sha256: ordinary filesystem input material includes declared pattern order, missing patterns and sorted path/kind/sha256/bytes/mode entries; tracked-Markdown material includes selection/limits/scoped patterns and entries; package material contains sorted selected relative path+sha256 only, no filemode. This precision preserves actual owner; it is not a new top-level key component or a specialized C018 change. Ignore legacy unused profile/runtime helpers as key authority. Admission/prerequisites/cache-enabled/eligibleordinary conditions/source-record/evidence remain separate. Missing/corrupt owned optional payload or retained result is a real-execution miss; foreign/corrupt authoritative ledger preserved/rejected. Reuse item wraps unmodified original execution/source records, original result identity and provenance; it does not synthesize a new run, code outcome, current clock pair/sample or Task proof. Root current-request configuration provenance is distinct from source provenance.
semantics.subject: Strict7-field documentation declaration version1, absolute selected registered root, actual SHA1/SHA256 full commit/tree identities, canonical relative Markdown paths, required subset, rename sources+destinations and deletions. Working mode accepts omitted documentation_scope and optional working scope_paths; supplied declaration conflicts. Committed mode requires nonnull declaration and scope_paths:null. Wrong type/version/root/object/candidate/dirty/unlisted target yields typed admission error before spawn. Subject owner rechecks actual candidate before evidence is confirmed; later change is unconfirmed with known child result retained. Caller supplied null is invalid, not ABSENT. Configured environment_key carries only admitted JSON; policy clear_keys scrub inherited scope signals. Ordinary unrelated profile rejects declaration. No symlink tests/investigation.
semantics.publication: Calibrate explicit selected outsideGit profile, exact expected raw file SHA, eligible actual samples; preserve unknown raw keys/unrelated profiles. Publish known measured values plus separately generated operational report via owner. Stale hash => calibration_conflict and no file writes. Same values+report complete => unchanged; profile written/report failed => unconfirmed with truthful profile_written=true/report_written=false; repair selected report path and explicit request with current raw SHA completes report without another profile rewrite. Ordinary run/preview/list never rewrites config/docs.
semantics.state_and_failure: Selected state directory inside configured project state; file/lock/run/cache names explicitly configured; use existing project file modes/lock limits. Do not create Task or write TaskDB. Record_path/full response/streams reside under configured run roots. A prelaunch invalid batch preserves logical state and child counters. Capture failure returns known actual exit plus capture_complete=false and no verified sample/cache. Ledger/result-save failure preserves full captured files, status unconfirmed and error result_save_failed. Caller output fails only after committed record/full result: transport1/error output_write, persisted record is still truthful and readable; no pending-delivery framework or rerun.
semantics.opaque_values: Run IDs, exact paths from arranged tmp directories, Git hashes created by actual fixtures and monotonic audit values are validated independently and cross-referenced; do not generate functional expected values from product constants/enums/parsers/serializers. Generic standard hashlib on known literal bytes is allowed. Large canonical expected JSON lives in future test-owned fixture files, not inline test code.
semantics.toml_raw_types: Raw TOML has no null literal. Optional evidence_id/subject/regex total_group/stage_group and nonintegration producer/consumer are omitted when absent; known present values must have their declared nonnull types. Cache max_input_files/max_input_bytes are required only for tracked-Markdown mode. Nulls in result DTO are normalized absence, not a required TOML spelling. Policy JSON packages_path/suites_path explicitly null disables that optional catalogue; profile-only ordinary use does not require a fictitious package/suite. Selecting disabled kind returns typed unavailable. No fallback catalogue is substituted.
semantics.conditional_invocation: Policy runtime_adapters explicitly maps runtime_class/platform/invocation to an optional configured Windows command processor. No COMSPEC/cmd.exe hidden fallback. Preview composes exact exec argv or Windows [/d,/s,/c,list2cmdline(payload)] as data and declares actual availability; it never invokes Windows on Linux. Actual run uses only available POSIX owner/runtime; unsupported owner/platform is runtime_unavailable. This is contract/data coverage, not a native Windows port.
semantics.freshness: Only options.fresh:true bypasses reusable source explicitly, or an actual configured release gate disables reuse/requests fresh through its owner. No final option in this request grammar; unknown options.final is invalid_request, never an implicit fresh flag. A profile merely named ordinary-final remains ordinarily reusable. Existing Task caches unchanged.
semantics.record_vs_reuse: Real ProcessRun records belong to actual child attempts, carry actual exit/termination and two Clock observations only when executed. Package/suite execution results aggregate ordered real step records and own result_id/record_path/provenance; no fictitious aggregate child/PID/exit. A single profile has one step. Cache hit returns kind:reuse with cache.hit:true/source_result_id and complete UNMODIFIED source execution result, including original steps/process fields; source.cache and source clock pair remain historical, not newly observed. result operation accepts result_id and returns original execution item, without process creation or identity rewrite. Saved response owner allocates response_path before serializing full root; raw machine consumer gets full root, CLI common views point to that same saved body.
semantics.saved_output_failure: Shared output owner saves full response before emitting to either raw Python port or CLI view. On output_write failure, error.references.response_path/record_paths/streams expose only actually persisted addresses so caller can recover without knowing an undelivered ID; persisted successful result is not overwritten by delivery error. Before project/state readiness references are null/empty, no fake path. Pure read/preview may save diagnostic response under configured response_directory but must not change functional ledger/cache/profiles/samples.
semantics.suite_cache: Suite selects source scopes and ordered actual configured checks. Preserve reuse/fresh semantics through each selected source owner and any explicit configured whole-suite invocation, rather than invent a new universal whole-suite cache namespace. Package/source-result identities remain explicit; no native worker/shard or Task cache rewrite. Profile/source filtering is now explicit through suite_set; selected suite sources remain the full configured member source scopes, not merely the changed_paths filter. Whole-suite reuse, when actually configured, retains its source owner; the selection wrapper introduces no universal cache.
semantics.presentation_failure: Failure producing/emitting the selected view uses output_write and actual saved-response references; saved execution truth is unchanged. Raw Python result consumers and saved complete result never consume the broken preview.
semantics.cache_storage_and_profile_axes: Actual source-record tuple validation uses its stored original command/workload/runtime tuple; changing admitted current runtime does not add a new key field. Reuse remains subject to actual runtime/prerequisite availability and original retained evidence validation. An authoritative foreign ledger is rejected; cache portability is demonstrated only between registered same-project checkouts sharing the explicitly selected store.
semantics.aggregation: Single-operation batch validates all requests and all requested selections before executing any step. Admission failure: root invalid/unavailable, items empty, no functional writes or child. On execution, process selected items in request order; first non-passed item stops remaining requested items and dependency steps. Completed earlier items remain truthful, remaining selections explicit not_executed entries. Root status is first stopping outcome, otherwise passed; reuse takes original successful source status for this decision. Read/list/preview/calibrate each have operation-specific results; preview never creates a ProcessRun.

suite_selection.request: describe/preview/run accept exact {kind:suite_set,profile:fast|release,changed_paths:null|unique canonical repository-relative path array}. Existing {kind:suite,id} remains direct selection, no profile filtering. list kind:suites lists inventory; describe suite_set computes membership without executing. No caller-side filtering or hidden profile defaults.
suite_selection.membership: Read selected suites catalogue in declared array order. Keep each suite once if requested profile is an element of its configured profiles array. Profiles membership is authoritative; release does not automatically include fast-only suites. For changed_paths:null choose ALL members of that requested profile (donor add_tooling_suites behavior). changed_paths:[] chooses NONE. For nonempty changed_paths select a profile-member suite when ANY configured source equals a path or is a component-boundary ancestor (path begins source+ /). Source declarations are literal canonical path scopes, not globs or string-substring matching. All overlapping applicable suites are selected, not an arbitrary most-specific winner; declared suite/command order retained. A suite cannot occur twice even when several scopes/paths match.
suite_selection.source_result: suite_ids preserves catalogue order. source_matches is one row per chosen suite; sources preserve its configured source order and changed_paths preserve request order, retaining only actual matched pairs membership. For changed_paths:null all declared sources are reported and matched changed_paths is[]. unmatched_paths reports request paths matching no source across the entire valid catalogue, preserving request order; paths belonging only to another profile are filtered-by-profile, not called unmatched. Empty/no-matching selection returns reason empty_change_set/no_matching_source and statusready with items[], no fake success/run/process/ledger/history/cache effect.
suite_selection.nested_results: The suite_selection wrapper carries the request and selection rationale; it is not a ProcessRun or a cache namespace. describe contains configured suite descriptors; preview contains suite-ID preview DTOs; run contains suite-ID actual execution/reuse DTOs, in suite_ids order. Each selected suite preserves its own command order and real step records, actual source scopes and existing source cache semantics. Package dependency dedup is preserved within its owning package; suite IDs are deduped, separately declared commands across distinct suites are not silently eliminated. Stop on first failed/unconfirmed/unavailable/etc selected suite and show subsequent selected suites as not_executed. No wrapper PID, Clock pair, aggregate exit code or fictitious run_id. Nonempty successful run wrapper passed; empty wrapper ready. Root derives real nested stopping outcome or ready when nothing executed, and actual child codes remain in steps.
suite_selection.options: changed_paths selects suite membership only; options.scope_paths remains the separately declared check-input/cache scope and never secretly chooses suite profile/source membership. Existing options propagate through their actual selected check owner and remain validated before launch. Do not reinterpret changed_paths as documentation_scope or implicit fresh. Request duplicates/overlapping direct and set suite selections reject the later request before any child with the offending request selection field; selected catalogue IDs/order cannot be secretly substituted.
suite_selection.errors: Unknown profile/wrong selector type is invalid_request with actual request field/cause. Invalid/absolute/traversing/noncanonical changed path is invalid_options with its exact selection.changed_paths index and recovery. Legitimate unrelated canonical paths are reported as unmatched/no_matching_source, never a full fallback. Duplicate suite IDs, malformed source declarations, missing/cyclic commands and broken profile membership are invalid_suites naming the actual catalogue element. Overlapping valid scopes yield all matching suites; they are not ambiguity errors. Conflicting declarations are diagnosed before execution. Selecting suite_set with explicitly disabled suites_path:null yields suites_unavailable identifying policy.suites_path and requiring an explicit catalogue; profile-only requests remain usable.
suite_selection.owner: Existing planned named-check policy/catalogue resolver owns membership and reports it to preview/execution composition. Generic runner owns actual child/capture only. Canonical donor baseline503c9f1a verify.sh add_tooling_suites502+ explicitly filters profile membership; declared source scopes feed suite sources/cache. Adapt this through project-local declared selector instead of ERP shell command-name branches. No new product source at design.

actionable_errors.schema: Error exactly code,field,cause,reason,recovery,references. code is one of declared stable error_codes. field is actual supplied input location: request.items[N]..., policy.timing..., profiles.commands[N]..., packages.packages[N]..., suites.suites[N]..., or the exact failing named runtime/storage resource. Preserve dot/bracket spelling. cause is a nonempty concrete explanation; reason and recovery identify that specific defect/resource and a usable correction. No generic catalogue string is a complete accepted error. Multiple defects diagnose first in schema-declaration/request order without losing its field. Duplicate source JSON keys name the duplicated field location.
actionable_errors.context: Known numeric type/range failures name expected type/bound and observed type/value when safe. Missing inputs name missing field/resource; unsupported version names received and supported version; ambiguity names actual supplied selector and candidate IDs plus absent discriminating field; unavailable prerequisites name required executable/file/environment-key; configuration/runtime paths actually selected are reported without dumping raw sensitive values or full environment.
actionable_errors.classes: independent_oracles.error_classes provides only stable status/exit/classification, NOT fixed text/prefixes/default errors. independent_oracles.error_cases are complete exact field/cause/reason/recovery expectations for arranged cases; dynamic references are independently checked for actual files and full bytes. Additional supplied cases use similarly independent exact test-owned input/output fixtures rather than product template/enum generation. Generic root field is used only when the entire root cannot be parsed, never when a concrete bad field is known.
actionable_errors.readback: Result operation names request.items[N].result_id, never run_id. Missing selected result explains the requested ID and action to list/use a real saved result. Actual execution IDs remain process record fields only.
actionable_errors.failure_references: references retain only genuinely saved response/records/streams from the exact request. Empty/no-ready storage uses null/empty addresses. Transport/presentation failures link already persisted successful result without overwriting it. Fixed human error text and actual contextual fields are tested separately from opaque arranged path substitutions.
